newsitem.title: ITALY: Air passenger traffic in Italy up 6.2 pct in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Air passenger traffic in Italy up 6.2 pct in Sept.

text.p: Air passenger traffic to and from Italy rose 6.2 percent in September compared with September 1995 to 6.336 million, the national statistics institute ISTAT said on Monday.
It said the rise in the third quarter of 1996 was 6.3 percent compared with the corresponding period of 1995 to 19.186 million passengers.

In September, international passenger traffic to and from Italy rose 6.5 percent year-on-year to 3.224 million, with traffic on Italian airlines rising 8.6 percent and on foreign carriers by 5.2 percent, ISTAT said.
Domestic passenger traffic in September rose 6.0 percent to 3.112 million, the institute said.
